module.name: Coaching Julie — Monday to Saturday
module.description: A week-long journey, a small daily challenge and a quiz to anchor the concepts, to make real progress on your topic.

exercice.objectif: Spot a situation where your voice wasn't heard enough, and prepare a simple sentence to make it heard next time.
Put that sentence into practice in a meeting or exchange, and observe the reaction you get.
Identify a task you could delegate today, and actually delegate it.
Ask a colleague or someone close to you for constructive feedback on your posture this week.
Note down a success from the week, however small, and share it with someone.

bilan.description: Saturday review: a synthesis of the week (exercises + quiz), then the choice between going deeper with your e-Coach (redo the questions you got wrong) or being connected.

module.name: Self-Promotion and Personal Value Test
module.description: Making your results known and openly claiming the impact of your work.

exercice.objectif: The inventory of invisible achievements: identify and quantify your real, undocumented contributions. Review your last 6 months, list 5 wins that weren't in your original job description, attach an impact metric to each, then add them to your impact journal.

The "Impact Matrix" Pitch: turn an execution task into an executive value story. Pick a recurring task, rephrase it as [Optimization action] + [Process transformation] = [Strategic/financial result], then rehearse a 30-second pitch until it's fluent.

Anchoring and Amplification in Meetings: secure ownership of your ideas. Before your next key meeting, prepare a direct anchor sentence for your recommendation, and agree with a trusted colleague to amplify each other by name.

The Salary "Fact Sheet" Simulation: prepare a financial negotiation based on hard data. Build a one-page sheet summarizing your 3 biggest contributions with their metrics, set your target figure from market benchmarks, then role-play announcing it confidently.

The Sponsor Map: structure your influence network and find strategic allies. List 3 leaders outside your direct line who hold weight, identify a topic to seek their input on, and plan a first contact with at least one of them within 14 days.

bilan.description: Saturday review: a synthesis of the week (exercises + quiz), then the choice between going deeper with your e-Coach (redo the questions you got wrong) or being connected.
